senses.gloss:
n. (-व्यं)
A worthless or good for nothing object.
E.
अ neg. द्रव्य thing.

m. (-द्रिः)
1 A tree.
2 A mountain.
3 The sun.
4 A measure.
E.
अद to eat, and क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-ला)
The earth.
E.
अद्रि a mountain, and कील a pin or bolt.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced or found in the hills.
n. (-जं)
Red chalk.
f. (-जा)
A name of PĀRVATĪ or DURGĀ, the daughter [] of HIMĀLA, ruler of the HIMĀLAYA mountain, and hence this her appellation, mountain-born.
E.
अद्रि, and ज, from जन to be born.

f. (-या)
A name of PĀRVATĪ, the daughter of the mountain HIMĀLAYA.
E.
अद्रि, and तनया daughter.

m. (-तिः)
Hima, lord of mountains: also similar compounds, as अद्रीन्द्र, अद्रिराज्, &c.

m. (-भित्)
A name of INDRA.
E.
अद्रि, and भिद who breaks; the splitter of mountains, (with his thunderbolt.)

mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु)
Mountaineer, mountain-born.
m. (-भूः)
A plant, (Salvinea cucullata.)
E.
अद्रि, and भू born.

m. (-राट्)
The king of mountains, the HIMĀLAYA mountains; the snowy range on the north of Hindustan, confounded with the mythological ruler of them, and the father of PĀRVATĪ.
E.
अद्रि, and राज् a king, the king of mountains, deservedly so called, being the loftiest in the world.

m. (-ह्निः)
Fire on a mountain, a volcano.
E.
अद्रि, and वह्नि fire.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A peak, the horn or summit of a mountain.
E.
अद्रि, and शृङ्ग a horn.

m. (-रः)
Iron.
E.
अद्रि, and सार essence.

m. (-शः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 Also of HIMĀLAYA, as king of mountains.
E.
अद्रि, and ईश a master.

m. (-हः)
Mildness, moderation, the absence of tyranny or oppression.
E.
अ neg. द्रोह tyranny.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Innocuous, mild.
E.
अ neg. द्रोहिन् violent.
